items.question: How many years is an ownership deed for residential units granted to expatriates in Abu Dhabi valid under the real estate law?
items.gold: Expatriates are granted ownership deeds of residential units for a period of 99 years.
items.fact: Abu Dhabi expatriate ownership deeds last 99 years

items.question: Is there an age limit for buying property in Dubai?
items.gold: No, there is no age limit to own property in Dubai.
items.fact: Dubai property ownership has no age limit
